## Preprints

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
**Machine Learning and the Random Walk Puzzle: Forecasting the CAD/USD Exchange Rate with Expanding Window Evaluation and SHAP Interpretability**

Agyekum, L., Agyemang, E.F., Ampomah, O., Acheampong, K., Boadi, E., Amakye, P.Y., Tchorly, F.S., **Adu Bonsu, E.**, & Nyarko, E. (2026)

*arXiv preprint* [arXiv:2606.15058](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15058)

Benchmarks five ML models against random-walk and exponential-smoothing baselines for monthly CAD/USD forecasting, using expanding-window evaluation, Diebold–Mariano testing, and SHAP interpretability.
:::

## Manuscripts in Preparation

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
**A Game-Theoretic Framework for Detecting Algorithmic Bias in Clinical Prediction Models: The Vulnerability Index Approach**

Adu Bonsu, E.

*Target: Statistics in Medicine*

Introduces the V(S) vulnerability-indexed framework for detecting subgroup-level algorithmic bias in clinical AI. Validated on MIMIC-III (n = 46,476) and UNM Trauma Registry (n = 3,132) data.

[Draft available upon request]{.badge .badge-secondary}
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
**Multilevel Determinants of Childhood Anemia in Sub-Saharan Africa: A Comprehensive Analysis of Demographic and Health Surveys**

Adu Bonsu, E. et al.

*Target: PLOS Medicine*
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
**Variational EM Algorithm for ERGM Mixture Models: Application to Disease Transmission Networks**

Attandoh, H. P., Adu Bonsu, E. et al.

*Target: Journal of the Royal Statistical Society, Series C*
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
**Missing Data Sensitivity Analysis in Clinical Trials: An MNAR Tipping-Point Approach**

Adu Bonsu, E. et al.

*Target: BMC Medical Research Methodology*

Reanalysis of a clinical dataset applying MICE under MAR and tipping-point sensitivity analysis for MNAR departures.
:::

## Software

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
**TSGap: A Python Library for Composable Time-Series Missingness Simulation**

Oripov, F., Korchagina, K., **Adu Bonsu, E.**, Bilgin, A., & Aras, S. (2026) · *Under review*

Open-source package separating missingness mechanisms (MCAR/MAR/MNAR) from patterns (pointwise, block, monotone, decay, Markov) for imputation-method benchmarking. [github.com/feruzoripov/tsgap](https://github.com/feruzoripov/tsgap)
:::
